# this = the winning side (END_EFFECT set_winner): the end call while the game runs.
ck3xbl_st_win_effect = {
	set_winner = yes
}

# this = combat, scope:ck3xbl_st_cur_bid = its steering bid. The hard modifier on every commander of both sides
# (HARD_CARRIER all); commanders who took over after fates or joins get it on the next pulse.
# The side lists may be empty (side_commander was unset at on_combat_start, in game 2026-10-04), so the commander of every
# army in the combat gets it too (a province holds one combat at a time).
ck3xbl_st_keep_hard_effect = {
	combat_attacker = {
		every_side_commander = { ck3xbl_st_give_hard_effect = yes }
	}
	combat_defender = {
		every_side_commander = { ck3xbl_st_give_hard_effect = yes }
	}
	location = {
		every_army_in_location = {
			limit = { is_army_in_combat = yes }
			army_commander ?= { ck3xbl_st_give_hard_effect = yes }
		}
	}
	ck3xbl_st_keep_hard_cover_effect = yes
}
# this = a commander of the steered combat: the hard modifier for this battle (ck3xbl_st_hard_bid), listed in ck3xbl_st_chars.
ck3xbl_st_give_hard_effect = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_character_modifier = ck3xbl_st_hard } } add_character_modifier = { modifier = ck3xbl_st_hard days = 30 } }
	set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_st_hard_bid value = scope:ck3xbl_st_cur_bid }
	ck3xbl_st_list_character_effect = yes
}
# this = combat, scope:ck3xbl_st_cur_bid (HARD_COVER, steering.mjs): ck3xbl_st_att_has_cmd / _def_has_cmd = the side has a commander
# (in its side list or at the head of one of its armies in the combat); while one side has none, the carriers of the hard
# modifier on the other side also carry ck3xbl_st_hard_cover, and lose it once that side has a commander again.
ck3xbl_st_keep_hard_cover_effect = {
	save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_st_att_has_cmd value = 0 }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_st_def_has_cmd value = 0 }
	combat_attacker = { if = { limit = { any_side_commander = { is_alive = yes } } save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_st_att_has_cmd value = 1 } } }
	combat_defender = { if = { limit = { any_side_commander = { is_alive = yes } } save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_st_def_has_cmd value = 1 } } }
	location = {
		every_army_in_location = {
			limit = { is_army_in_combat = yes exists = army_commander }
			if = { limit = { involved_combat_side = { is_combat_side_attacker = yes } } save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_st_att_has_cmd value = 1 } }
			else = { save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_st_def_has_cmd value = 1 } }
		}
	}
	combat_attacker = { save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_st_enemy_has_cmd value = scope:ck3xbl_st_def_has_cmd } every_side_commander = { ck3xbl_st_set_hard_cover_effect = yes } }
	combat_defender = { save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_st_enemy_has_cmd value = scope:ck3xbl_st_att_has_cmd } every_side_commander = { ck3xbl_st_set_hard_cover_effect = yes } }
	location = {
		every_army_in_location = {
			limit = { is_army_in_combat = yes exists = army_commander }
			if = { limit = { involved_combat_side = { is_combat_side_attacker = yes } } save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_st_enemy_has_cmd value = scope:ck3xbl_st_def_has_cmd } }
			else = { save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_st_enemy_has_cmd value = scope:ck3xbl_st_att_has_cmd } }
			army_commander = { ck3xbl_st_set_hard_cover_effect = yes }
		}
	}
}
# this = a commander of the steered combat, scope:ck3xbl_st_enemy_has_cmd = whether the enemy side has a commander: a carrier of
# this battle's hard modifier gets ck3xbl_st_hard_cover (ck3xbl_st_cover_bid) while the enemy has none; otherwise this battle's cover
# comes off.
ck3xbl_st_set_hard_cover_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:ck3xbl_st_enemy_has_cmd = 0 has_variable = ck3xbl_st_hard_bid var:ck3xbl_st_hard_bid = scope:ck3xbl_st_cur_bid }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_character_modifier = ck3xbl_st_hard_cover } } add_character_modifier = { modifier = ck3xbl_st_hard_cover days = 30 } }
		set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_st_cover_bid value = scope:ck3xbl_st_cur_bid }
		ck3xbl_st_list_character_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = ck3xbl_st_cover_bid var:ck3xbl_st_cover_bid = scope:ck3xbl_st_cur_bid }
		remove_character_modifier = ck3xbl_st_hard_cover
		remove_variable = ck3xbl_st_cover_bid
	}
}

# this = combat side: ck3xbl_st_dmg_pp = the damage lever its owners get from its gain (-50..+1900, the down part limited by
# the smallest headroom among its owners). The enemy's toughness lever covers what this cannot deliver.
ck3xbl_st_side_dmg_pp_effect = {
	save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_st_room value = 50 }
	save_temporary_scope_as = ck3xbl_st_side
	combat = {
		location = {
			every_army_in_location = {
				limit = { is_army_in_combat = yes involved_combat_side = { this = scope:ck3xbl_st_side } }
				army_owner = { save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_st_room value = { value = scope:ck3xbl_st_room max = ck3xbl_st_dmg_headroom_value } } }
			}
		}
	}
	clear_saved_scope = ck3xbl_st_side
	set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_st_dmg_pp value = { value = var:ck3xbl_st_gain subtract = 1 multiply = 100 round = yes max = 1900 min = { value = scope:ck3xbl_st_room multiply = -1 } } }
}

# this = an army owner of the steered combat; scope:ck3xbl_st_g = the gain of its side, scope:ck3xbl_st_g_enemy and
# scope:ck3xbl_st_dmg_enemy = the enemy side's gain and damage lever:
#   damage = 100 (G - 1) within -min(50, headroom)..+1900; knights = damage within -50..+1900 (KNIGHT_LEVER follow);
#   toughness = 100 (1 / res - 1), res = G_enemy / (1 + damage_enemy / 100), within -min(40, headroom)..+900.
# Levers are scaled modifiers (MODIFIER_FORM scale); each is added for 30 days.
ck3xbl_st_set_owner_modifiers_effect = {
	save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_st_pp_dmg value = { value = scope:ck3xbl_st_g subtract = 1 multiply = 100 round = yes max = 1900 min = { value = ck3xbl_st_dmg_headroom_value multiply = -1 } } }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_st_pp_knight value = { value = scope:ck3xbl_st_pp_dmg max = 1900 min = -50 } }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_st_pp_tough value = { value = scope:ck3xbl_st_dmg_enemy divide = 100 add = 1 divide = scope:ck3xbl_st_g_enemy subtract = 1 multiply = 100 round = yes max = 900 min = { value = ck3xbl_st_tough_headroom_value multiply = -1 } } }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_st_pp_lever value = { value = scope:ck3xbl_st_pp_dmg min = 0 } }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = ck3xbl_st_dmg_up }
				NOT = { var:ck3xbl_st_dmg_up = scope:ck3xbl_st_pp_lever }
				AND = { scope:ck3xbl_st_pp_lever > 0 NOT = { has_character_modifier = ck3xbl_st_dmg_up } }
			}
		}
		remove_character_modifier = ck3xbl_st_dmg_up
		set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_st_dmg_up value = scope:ck3xbl_st_pp_lever }
		if = { limit = { scope:ck3xbl_st_pp_lever > 0 } add_character_modifier = { modifier = ck3xbl_st_dmg_up days = 30 } }
	}
	save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_st_pp_lever value = { value = scope:ck3xbl_st_pp_dmg multiply = -1 min = 0 } }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = ck3xbl_st_dmg_down }
				NOT = { var:ck3xbl_st_dmg_down = scope:ck3xbl_st_pp_lever }
				AND = { scope:ck3xbl_st_pp_lever > 0 NOT = { has_character_modifier = ck3xbl_st_dmg_down } }
			}
		}
		remove_character_modifier = ck3xbl_st_dmg_down
		set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_st_dmg_down value = scope:ck3xbl_st_pp_lever }
		if = { limit = { scope:ck3xbl_st_pp_lever > 0 } add_character_modifier = { modifier = ck3xbl_st_dmg_down days = 30 } }
	}
	save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_st_pp_lever value = { value = scope:ck3xbl_st_pp_tough min = 0 } }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = ck3xbl_st_tough_up }
				NOT = { var:ck3xbl_st_tough_up = scope:ck3xbl_st_pp_lever }
				AND = { scope:ck3xbl_st_pp_lever > 0 NOT = { has_character_modifier = ck3xbl_st_tough_up } }
			}
		}
		remove_character_modifier = ck3xbl_st_tough_up
		set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_st_tough_up value = scope:ck3xbl_st_pp_lever }
		if = { limit = { scope:ck3xbl_st_pp_lever > 0 } add_character_modifier = { modifier = ck3xbl_st_tough_up days = 30 } }
	}
	save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_st_pp_lever value = { value = scope:ck3xbl_st_pp_tough multiply = -1 min = 0 } }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = ck3xbl_st_tough_down }
				NOT = { var:ck3xbl_st_tough_down = scope:ck3xbl_st_pp_lever }
				AND = { scope:ck3xbl_st_pp_lever > 0 NOT = { has_character_modifier = ck3xbl_st_tough_down } }

# this = character: its owner levers off (every lever modifier and its variable removed).
ck3xbl_st_owner_levers_off_effect = {
	remove_character_modifier = ck3xbl_st_dmg_up
	remove_variable = ck3xbl_st_dmg_up
	remove_character_modifier = ck3xbl_st_dmg_down
	remove_variable = ck3xbl_st_dmg_down
	remove_character_modifier = ck3xbl_st_tough_up
	remove_variable = ck3xbl_st_tough_up
